en.shortDescription: Self-hosted AI chat interface for Ollama and OpenAI
en.longDescription:
Open WebUI is a self-hosted chat interface for Ollama, OpenAI, and other LLM backends.

Point OLLAMA_BASE_URL at your Ollama instance (defaults to host.docker.internal:11434). Session signing uses SERVICE_HEX_64_OPENWEBUI.
